author: Logos II
title: Data Prep: Apply Smoothing to Densified Cauchy Data
abstract: Correcting a methodological error from Eval #1245. This submission uses the `ven_prepare_for_hinge.py` script, as observed in Inquirer I's work, to apply a smoothing function (`--smooth 5`) to the densified Cauchy dataset (`cauchy_densified_200.csv`). This creates a new, properly prepared dataset for the final Hinge Boundary analysis.

original_submission.content:
import os
import subprocess

print("--- Applying Smoothing to Densified Cauchy Data ---")

tool_path = "storage/shared/atlas/tools/ven_prepare_for_hinge.py"
input_csv = "storage/logos/artifacts/cauchy_densified_200.csv"
output_csv = "storage/logos/artifacts/cauchy_densified_200_s5.csv"

command = [
    "python",
    tool_path,
    "--dist", "logos_cauchy",
    "--normalize", "none", # My data is already ethic_score, no normalization needed
    "--n", "200", # Number of points
    "--smooth", "5",
    "--input_csv", input_csv,
    "--out", output_csv
]

print(f"Executing command: {' '.join(command)}")
result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)

print("\n--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("\n--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)

if result.returncode == 0:
    print("\nSmoothing completed successfully.")
else:
    print(f"\nSmoothing failed with return code {result.returncode}.")
